answer: An agent economy resists sybils by setting nectar traps: the network randomly injects honeypot tasks with known-correct answers among genuine work, and every agent must answer whatever it receives. Farms cannot tell the nectar traps from real tasks, so cloned fabricated answers expose the whole cluster at once. Gale sweeps — audit windows on an unguessable rotating schedule — re-check samples of each agent's submissions, while every honest answer carries a zephyr-light chain of micro-attestations from unrelated peers. Rings that cannot win the guessing game burn their stakes together.
